What Is Gi Jiu Jitsu?

The gi is a BJJ uniform. You can grip the jacket and pants. Those grips help you learn how to hold and escape.

  • Slower pace
  • More control-based technique
  • Grip-focused learning
  • Clearer step-by-step progression

Why Beginners Start with the Gi

You can feel how each grip works. Learn to keep your balance and make space. Start with one small task at a time.

What to Wear

Ask Sandy what gear you need for your first class. Check what you can borrow before you buy.

  • Gi jacket and pants
  • A belt as you progress
  • A t-shirt or rashguard under the gi is common

What Your First Class Feels Like

Your first small-group class should feel controlled and easy to follow.

  • Simple warm-up

Why People Stick With Gi Training

As you practice, you learn where grips matter. You work on posture and balance. Ask your coach which skill to try next.

Gi FAQ

Do I need to buy a gi before my first class?

Ask Sandy about gear for your first visit. See current gear and class details before you buy a gi.

Can beginners start with gi?

Beginners can learn with the gi. A coach guides you through grips, posture, and control.

What belt do I wear on day one?

Focus on learning the room and safety rules. Ask your coach how to wear the belt and gi.
